description: A standalone SQLite3-backed knowledge base for tracking projects, observations, concepts, decision records, and narrative documents across independent experiments in the rsdoiel/Laboratory workspace. Extracted from the harvey terminal agent's knowledge.go, this module provides a typed CRUD API (Open, AddProject, AddObservationWithSource, AddConceptWithIdentifier, Search, and related methods) plus UUID-based row identity and a SQL/ATTACH-based cross-machine merge tool, so other experiments and language-model harnesses can read and write structured observations directly instead of raw sqlite3 CLI inserts. Ships cmd/kb, a single "kb VERB ARGS" binary (matching the git/go command model) covering the full API with both human-readable and --json output, a merge verb for reconciling two databases that drifted independently, and a read-only interactive TUI browser for exploring projects, observations, and concepts. It also indexes Decision Records -- episode-scoped Markdown files with YAML frontmatter, kept in a project's decisions/ directory -- as first-class rows, so the reasoning behind a decision is retrievable rather than living only in files the knowledge base never reads. Inline [[wikilink]] tagging and frontmatter tags/keywords resolve to concepts at ingest time (records and documents alike), an embedder-free RecallByConceptNames/MatchConceptNames pair gives small/CPU-only models a cheap concept-based retrieval path ahead of any vector RAG, and a documents/document_sections schema ingests narratives and articles (Markdown, Fountain, plain text) at graduated abstraction levels -- a document-level gist plus per-section summaries, each going through an explicit human review step before being trusted as searchable content.
name: knowledge
softwareRequirements: git >= 2.0 (runtime, for kb document frontmatter's provenance detection)
releaseNotes: Offline semantic search (preview). A separate semantic build of kb (make semantic, or go install github.com/rsdoiel/knowledge/semantic/cmd/kb@semantic/v0.0.29; Go 1.27.3 or later) finds rows by meaning with no daemon and no network after the model is fetched. New: kb search -semantic and -hybrid with -min-score (rows ranked by their best 400-character passage, shown with score and passage; exits 1 nothing above the cutoff, 65 index from another model, 66 no model or index, 75 index being built); kb model install|fetch|list for the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding model (Apache-2.0, about 87 MB, checked against recorded SHA-256 sums); kb embed (-status, -rebuild) to build and refresh the index, interruptible and resumable; write verbs keep an existing index current; kb init keeps the model and index out of git; Tab in the interface search prompt cycles words, meaning and both. The plain kb is unchanged and kb search TERM output is byte-identical, proven by a golden-file test. Measured on 34 labelled queries (indicative): plain search recall@10 0.15, -semantic 0.88 with MRR 0.82; the default cutoff is 0.35. First index about 16 minutes on a Raspberry Pi 5 and 5.6 minutes on a Mac Mini (macOS arm64); a search takes 0.2 to 0.5 seconds. Run for real on linux/arm64 and macOS arm64; built but not run on linux/macOS amd64 and Windows. The release archives still hold the plain kb; build the semantic one from source. Building from source now needs Go 1.27.3 or later, and make check-release enforces that the go.mod, codemeta.json and nested module agree (make check-go-version). The test suite no longer needs GNU Make 4 (macOS ships 3.81).
